en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a large crowd gathered along a seaside promenade and railway line. On the right, train carriages stand on tracks running parallel to the waterfront, with the sea, small boats, and a pier with masts and ships in the distance. On the left, multi‑story buildings line the street. The scene depicts a festive or ceremonial event with dense crowds filling the street. Printed text in Greek and French at the top identifies the scene as being in Patras and referring to shooting games or competitions. A website watermark appears at the bottom.
